svg.text: Posts: six 50 x 50 mm, 1,750 mm long, in two rows of three

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (front and back) at both ends and the middle; rows 450 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rails: six 50 x 75 mm, 2,200 mm long, screwed to the inside faces

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the posts, two per shelf; tops 25 mm below each shelf top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slats: 15 per shelf, 95 x 25 mm, 350 mm long, across the rails,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 54 mm gaps for air; two screws each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shelf tops 300, 850 and 1,400 mm above the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stand the rack against a long wall, 100 mm from each end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wall; two steel angle brackets fix the end posts' tops to the wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: square, no rocking; each shelf carries 160 kg (8 crates).
